description: Primary screen where students interact with the 25-minute timer and view their daily session count. This screen loads the persisted session count on launch and increments it when a session completes.

props.text: Primary screen where students interact with the 25-minute timer and view their daily session count. This screen loads the persisted session count on launch and increments it when a session completes.

props.title: Timer display showing countdown from 25:00 to 0:00
Start button to begin the timer
Pause button to pause the running timer
Reset button to reset timer to 25:00
Daily session counter display showing number of completed sessions
Session complete confirmation message when timer reaches 0:00
